jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Data Analyst – General Job Description

Job Title

Data Analyst

Job Summary

A Data Analyst collects, cleans, analyzes, and interprets data to help organizations make informed business decisions. The role involves working with structured and unstructured datasets, creating reports and dashboards, identifying trends, and providing actionable insights to stakeholders.

⸻

Key Responsibilities

* Collect data from multiple internal and external sources.
* Clean, validate, and preprocess datasets for analysis.
* Analyze large datasets to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies.
* Create dashboards and reports using visualization tools.
* Develop SQL queries to extract and manipulate data.
* Perform statistical analysis and generate business insights.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand reporting requirements.
* Monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and recommend improvements.
* Automate repetitive reporting processes.
* Ensure data quality, consistency, and accuracy.
* Document analytical processes and maintain data governance standards.
* Present findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

⸻

Required Skills

Technical Skills

* SQL (Joins, CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures)
* Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP)
* Python (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Scikit-learn)
* Power BI / Tableau / Looker Studio
* Statistics and Probability
* Data Cleaning and Data Wrangling
* Data Visualization
* ETL Concepts
* Basic Machine Learning (preferred)
* Database Management Systems (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server)

⸻

Soft Skills

* Analytical Thinking
* Problem Solving
* Critical Thinking
* Communication Skills
* Attention to Detail
* Business Understanding
* Time Management
* Team Collaboration
* Presentation Skills

⸻

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in:
    * Data Science
    * Computer Science
    * Information Technology
    * Statistics
    * Mathematics
    * Engineering
    * Business Analytics
    * Related quantitative field

Freshers with relevant internships and projects are commonly considered.

⸻

Preferred Qualifications

* Internship in Data Analytics or Business Intelligence
* Experience with Power BI or Tableau
* Knowledge of Python and SQL
* Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Familiarity with Git and version control

⸻

Common Daily Tasks

* Extract data using SQL.
* Clean and transform raw data.
* Build Power BI or Tableau dashboards.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports.
* Analyze sales, customer, finance, or operational data.
* Meet stakeholders to understand business requirements.
* Validate data accuracy before publishing reports.
* Automate recurring reports using Python or SQL.

⸻

Common Tools Used

* SQL Server / MySQL / PostgreSQL
* Microsoft Excel
* Power BI
* Tableau
* Python
* Jupyter Notebook
* Google Sheets
* Git/GitHub
* VS Code
* Azure Data Studio

⸻

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Report accuracy
* Dashboard adoption
* Query performance
* Data quality
* Automation rate
* Business impact of insights
* Turnaround time for reports

⸻

Typical Career Path

1. Data Analyst (Fresher)
2. Senior Data Analyst
3. Business Analyst
4. Analytics Consultant
5. BI Developer
6. Analytics Manager
7. Data Scientist
8. Lead Data Analyst
9. Head of Analyst
